DDL	CREATE DATABASE mydb1
SESSION	USE mydb1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1 USING parquet AS SELECT 1 AS i1
DDL	CREATE DATABASE mydb2
SESSION	USE mydb2
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1 USING parquet AS SELECT 20 AS i1
SESSION	SET spark.sql.crossJoin.enabled = true
SESSION	USE mydb1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM t1, mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM t1, mydb2.t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb2.t1
SESSION	USE mydb2
READ	SELECT i1 FROM t1, mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM t1, mydb2.t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb2.t1
READ	SELECT db1.t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb2.t1
SESSION	SET spark.sql.crossJoin.enabled = false
SESSION	USE mydb1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1 FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1.x.y.* FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1 FROM mydb1.t1
SESSION	USE mydb2
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM t1
SESSION	USE mydb1
DDL	CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT * FROM t1
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1 USING parquet AS SELECT 1 AS i2
READ	SELECT * FROM v1
SESSION	USE mydb2
SESSION	CREATE TEMP VIEW v2 AS SELECT * FROM t1
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1 USING parquet AS SELECT 1 AS i2
READ	SELECT * FROM v2
DDL	DROP DATABASE mydb1 CASCADE
DDL	DROP DATABASE mydb2 CASCADE
